GCSE Results Day 2026
We proudly celebrated the achievements of our fabulous GCSE students on results day. Congratulations to you all on your results, which are a reflection of your hard work, commitment and determination. We are incredibly proud of everything you have accomplished and wish each and every one of you every success and happiness in the years ahead.
A Level Results 2026
Therfield students have been celebrating the best set A Level results of recent years as 25% of our grades were A*-A grades and over 50% of grades were at A*-B. We congratulate all of our students who have a lot of exciting universities/destinations lined up for their next steps. This includes some stand out results from students who have worked incredibly hard:
There are a number of students who have achieved excellent apprenticeships this year too and we are extremely proud of our students and congratulations to all of them.
We are looking forward to welcoming our new Year 12s in September and celebrating with them when they pick up their GCSE grades next Thursday.
Today represents the end of a phase of each student's education, and the opportunity to recognise and celebrate what they have achieved. We are delighted to be able to congratulate the Class of 2026 for their resilience, contribution to the wider school and the many achievements along the way. This group of young people have truly left a mark at Therfield over their seven-year journey. We wish them well as they move on to the next phase of their lives with our full support and best wishes.
